name: Cybersecurity Strategy of Estonia (2024–2027)
owner: Majandus- ja Kommunikatsiooniministeerium (Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications)
description: Fourth-generation Cybersecurity Strategy of Estonia (2024–2027). Four-generation Estonian national cybersecurity strategy series (2008–2013, 2014–2017, 2019–2022, and 2024–2027) establishing strategic goals for resilient digital infrastructure, R&D and talent development, international cyber diplomacy, and whole-of-society cyber hygiene.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Majandus- ja Kommunikatsiooniministeerium (Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications) (mkm.ee) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Majandus- ja Kommunikatsiooniministeerium (Ministry of Economic Affairs and Communications) (mkm.ee).
